title: Every metamonovalued funcoid is monovalued
exact_target: Does preservation of arbitrary meets by composition on the right imply single-valuedness for funcoids? The pinned author manuscript states this implication within an equivalence theorem. \href{https://github.com/vporton/agt-combined/blob/759e45cced7769cf3a84ce60ed6c30f4ce9ffa8e/chap-funcoids.tex}{[S4]}
